body.kept: Whole in the author's words: every utterance as it came, typed or spoken, the session's reading which; the typing's slips corrected on the word. His direction, written under the rule for another project and pasted here, kept as he gave it. After each, the essence of the session's answer in its own voice. The work stands in cfde5be, How the code is written; 8389ebb, the code made modules at the root with each store moved whole; ef74b65, the components made again from the root; and in the store's own commits.

name: A tenth session, kept whole: how the code is written, and the code made modules at the root

body.opens: Built by the tenth session on 2026-11-11: step 1, the code as modules; step 2, one act, one commit; step 3, the engine on attachments; step 4 in part, every store its root, gone said in runs; step 5, the site started from its store; and of step 6, the engine reading any store through Source, ids derived from what is read, and a git reader at the command line. Next, in order: first, the author's ask, a reader like a dashboard, a little of it, as a live monitor of the work; then the git reader's faults mended; then the cuts, the author's words into the author's store and the engine's types into its own, once the author says how a store taken away is born and where threads live; then git's root, routes through a tree's entries and the browser, once he says what a store that cannot give everything means and how names in entries read; the buffer when a stream exists; then how code mounts and runs. Carried: the lexicon a pure function, Terms with pages, rules that recurse, values in nested records as facts; how a root is known, the home's root, names a root makes many. What waits on the author is awaiting(); the session in short is tldr().

body.purpose: The engine reading any store through one contract; then a git integration, read only, at the command line first: its shape, its ids derived from what it reads, designed and attacked first. The buffer waits for a stream.
